selected.prompt: Create ONE isolated full-body RIGHT-FACING LATERAL REFERENCE PROFILE of the feminine Raw Shock morph from the commercial Wii edition of Silent Hill: Shattered Memories (2009). The supplied in-game images are the authoritative design reference; retain the nonhuman pale pink-grey smooth game-creature surface, oval feature-poor head with the distinctive closed thick horizontal mouth/lip ridge and sealed eyes, narrow hunched shoulders, long arms, the native feminine torso/hip morphology, thin bent legs and unusually elongated pointed/high-arched feet. Use the consistent morphology on the left figure of image 1 and the standing separate figure to the right of image 2, not a mix of different transformation states. The last image helps the side silhouette. Exactly one creature with two arms and two legs, complete hands and feet, no extra limb. Turn its whole head, thorax and hips toward the right edge in a quiet neutral slightly hunched waiting stance; keep the same proportions and character identity. Slight separation of far limbs is permitted for readability. This is a static archive/pursuit-encounter reference, not a fighting stance or a new playable fighter. Preserve the commercial upright morphology, not a quadrupedal concept-art pose. Do not turn the creature into an ordinary human woman, do not add clothes, weapons, nipples or explicit anatomical detail, seductive posing, wounds or blood. One subject only, no Harry, other Raw Shocks, interaction, environment, HUD, reticle, grain lines, floor, shadow, text, labels or multiple views. Render a detailed native game-model-style raster under neutral diffuse light with actual transparent alpha outside the creature. Entire body and all extremities fit with at least 8 percent clear margins on every edge, about 75–80 percent of canvas height.

selected.originalPrompt: Create ONE isolated complete transparent-background reference-profile raster of the ABSTRACT / geometric Raw Shock variant as actually seen in the commercial Wii version of Silent Hill: Shattered Memories (2009), using the three supplied in-game captures as the authoritative morphology. Select the geometric stepped ring/cross-shaped head with the central circular opening seen on the separate creature at the upper-left of image 1 and the left Raw Shock beside Harry in image 2. Keep this chosen head state consistent; do not mix it with the tall U-shaped head variant in the same captures. The body has segmented horizontal fleshy bands with dark open gaps, thin articulated arms and legs, long hands and small stretched feet, in the muted pale pink-grey native game material. The whole body remains one Raw Shock entity. Show a RIGHT-FACING LATERAL PROFILE in a neutral slightly hunched upright waiting stance consistent with the commercial capture, with two complete arms, two complete legs and all fingers/toes in frame. The creature faces the right edge; a tiny camera offset may reveal the central head opening and far limbs without returning to a front portrait. Do not use the quadrupedal concept-art posture, do not invent a giant block carapace, metal robot parts, weapon, ordinary human face or new anatomical growths. This is a neutral morphology reference for an invulnerable pursuit encounter, not a fighting stance and not a playable combatant. Render only this ONE creature, without Harry, other creatures, grasping action, corridor, grain/noise overlay, HUD, reticle, captions, floor or shadow. Preserve the observed complete silhouette in a clean native-resolution game-model-style raster; true transparent alpha outside and in open gaps. Diffuse neutral light, generous at least 8 percent margins around all extremities. No added blood or injury.
